I understand you want clarity on the checked baggage allowance — happy to help.

Policy answer: The complimentary checked baggage allowance is 23 kg per passenger for all domestic flights. Each checked bag’s dimensions (length + width + height) must not exceed 158 cm (62 inches). Any individual piece of baggage weighing more than 32 kg cannot be accepted as checked baggage and must be transported as cargo.

Would you like help with excess baggage fees, pre-booking additional weight, or guidance on dimensions and packing?

Policy answer:
- The maximum weight allowed for your single piece of cabin baggage is 7 kg.
- You may also carry one small personal item (e.g., laptop bag, small handbag, or infant food bag) that must fit under the seat in front of you.

Policy answer:
- Excess checked baggage is charged at a flat rate of Rs 500 per kg.
- Charges must be paid in full at the airport check-in counter before a boarding pass can be issued.
- Alternatively, you may pre-book additional baggage weight online through the ACME Bharat Airlines website or mobile app up to 2 hours before departure to access discounted rates.

I’m sorry you’re going through this — I know how stressful it is when baggage doesn’t arrive. 

Policy answer:
- Report the delayed baggage and file a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at the airport baggage service desk within 4 hours of arrival.  
- ACME Bharat Airlines provides interim compensation of Rs 1,000 per day to cover essential items. This interim compensation is payable for up to a maximum of 5 days, or until the baggage is delivered, whichever is earlier.  
- If the baggage remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival, it will be formally classified as lost. Passengers are then eligible to claim compensation up to Rs 20,000 for lost baggage. To initiate a lost-baggage claim you must submit the PIR, the original baggage tag, and an itemized list of the contents with supporting receipts.

Next step question:
Have you already filed the PIR at the airport baggage service desk within 4 hours of arrival?

I’m sorry you’re dealing with uncertainty about your baggage — that must be stressful.

Policy answer:
- A bag is formally classified as lost if it remains untraced after 21 days from the date of flight arrival.
- Passengers are eligible to claim compensation up to Rs 20,000 for lost baggage.
- To initiate a claim you must submit the PIR, the original baggage tag, and an itemized list of the contents with supporting receipts.

Would you like guidance on how to gather the PIR, baggage tag, and receipts so you can start the claim?

The claim must include the original baggage tag and clear photos of the damage. Note that minor wear and tear, scratches, scuffs, or damage from over-packing or inherent defects are excluded.

Policy answer:
- If ACME Bharat Airlines cancels a scheduled flight (due to operational issues, technical difficulties, or scheduling changes), you may choose either:
  * A full refund of the unused ticket value, returned to the original form of payment; or
  * Free rebooking on the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight to your scheduled destination, with any fare differences and change fees waived.
- If the cancellation was due to adverse weather or other force majeure, the same two options apply (free rebooking or a full refund), but no monetary compensation such as hotel accommodation or meals will be provided.
- To request a refund or rebook, visit the "Manage Booking" section on the ACME Bharat Airlines website or contact our customer support center. If your ticket was bought through a third-party travel agency, you must contact that travel agent to initiate a refund.

Next step question:
Would you like me to help you with a refund or to rebook you on the next available ACME Bharat Airlines flight?

Policy answer:
- Members shall earn 5 AcmeMiles per Rs 100 spent on the base fare of an eligible ticket.
- The base fare calculation strictly excludes government-imposed taxes, airport development fees, passenger service charges, fuel surcharges, and GST.
- Miles are automatically credited within 48 hours of flight completion, provided the membership number was entered at booking.

Policy answer:

Policy answer:
- Yes. ACME Bharat Airlines requires that children aged between 5 and 12 years who are traveling alone must use the Unaccompanied Minor service (this service is mandatory for that age group).
- A service fee of Rs 3,000 per unaccompanied minor per flight sector is applicable.
- A parent or guardian must accompany the child to the departure check-in counter, complete the required indemnity forms, and remain at the airport until the flight has departed.
- At the destination, the child will only be released to the authorized guardian specified in the booking documents.

Samvedana ke saath: Dhanyavaad—main samajh sakta/ti hoon ki baggage allowance jaanna aapke liye zaroori hai. 

Policy ka jawaab:
- Checked baggage allowance: Complimentary checked baggage allowance "23 kg per passenger." Ye standard allowance sabhi domestic flights par lagu hoti hai. 
- Dimensions: Har checked bag ki 3 dimensions ka sum 158 cm (62 inches) se adhik nahi hona chahiye. Koi bhi ek piece jo 32 kg se zyaada ho, checked baggage ke roop mein accept nahin kiya jayega aur use cargo ke roop mein bhejna hoga.
- Cabin baggage: Har passenger ko exactly ek piece cabin baggage le jaane ki anumati hai, jiska maximum weight "7 kg" hai. Saath hi ek chhota personal item (laptop bag, small handbag, etc.) le ja sakte hain jo seat ke neeche fit ho.
Agar cabin baggage 7 kg se zyada ho ya prescribed dimensions se bade ho to use airport counter par check-in karwana padega.

Agla kadam ke liye sawaal:
Kya aap domestic flight ke liye poochh rahe hain aur kya aapko checked ya cabin baggage ke baare mein aur koi specific detail chahiye?

Mujhe afsos hai ki aapko is asuvidha ka samna karna pad raha hai.

Policy ke mutabik, agar flight ki departure scheduled time se 5 ghante late hai (yaani delay 4-6 ghante ke beech), to aap nimn me se ek option chun sakte hain:
- Rs 3,000 ka travel voucher jo ACME Bharat Airlines me bhavishya ki yatra ke liye valid hoga, YA
- Agli uplabdh ACME Bharat Airlines flight par muft rebooking (same destination), seat availability ke adheen, aur saare modification fees maaf kiye jayenge.

Kya aap voucher lena chahenge ya free rebooking karwana pasand karenge?

- Expired miles permanently forfeited hain aur inhe reinstated, transferred, ya monetary compensation mein badla nahi ja sakta.
